entities.brief: Rolling 4-week avg net equity flows for large caps

properties.key_insight: Large-cap net buys rose steadily from 2018, peaking around $7,000 million in early 2025 before turning negative at -$500 million in mid-2025.

entities.name: Equity inflows resurgence – Large cap net buys
entities.brief: 4-week avg net buys flipped to -$500M in mid-2025
entities.description: Represents the inflection where large-cap net buys turned negative for the first time since March 2025

entities.name: Table T2 – Equity inflows resurgence: Small caps rolling 4-wk avg flows flip positive
entities.brief: Rolling 4-week avg net buys for small caps indicating flip positive
entities.description: Shows volatile small-cap flows with sustained positive trend in 2024 and 2025

properties.table_content:
| Year | Small Cap Net Buys ($ mn) | Observation |
|---|---|---|
| 2008 | -200 to +400 | Highly volatile, large initial positive spike, then significant negative flows. |
| 2009 | -100 to +200 | Mixed flows, moderate positive peaks. |
| 2010 | -50 to +200 | Generally positive bias, occasional dips. |
| 2011 | -200 to +100 | Predominantly negative flows. |
| 2012 | -150 to +150 | Mixed, fluctuating around zero. |
| 2013 | -100 to +200 | Mixed flows, some positive spikes. |
| 2014 | -100 to +150 | Mixed, slight positive bias. |
| 2015 | -200 to +550 | Major peak inflow in mid-year, otherwise mixed to negative. |
| 2016 | -300 to +150 | Significant outflows, more pronounced negative periods. |
| 2017 | -150 to +200 | Mixed, with moderate positive spikes. |
| 2018 | -200 to +100 | Mixed, tending towards net outflows. |
| 2019 | -150 to +400 | Strong positive spikes, otherwise mixed. |
| 2020 | -150 to +400 | Strong positive spikes, particularly early in the year, then mixed. |
| 2021 | -200 to +400 | Significant positive spikes, some notable outflows. |
| 2022 | -200 to +200 | Mixed flows, fluctuating around zero. |
| 2023 | -100 to +250 | Mixed but with more frequent positive flows. |
| 2024 | -50 to +200 | Shift towards more consistent positive flows. |
| 2025 | 0 to +200 | Sustained positive flows ("flip positive" as per title). |
properties.key_insight: Small-cap net buys have shown a sustained positive trend in 2024 and year-to-date 2025, marking a 'flip positive'.

entities.name: Equity inflows resurgence – Small cap flows flip positive

entities.description: Small-cap net buys flipped positive in 2024 and remained positive through mid-2025

properties.key_insight: Mid-cap net buys peaked near $950mn in early 2022 before flipping to -$600mn in early 2023, and have persisted as outflows for four consecutive weeks through mid-2025.
